company.name: DexNet
company.shortDescription: DexNet is a technology and blockchain-based project that aims to build a decentralized peer-to-peer (P2P) network infrastructure.
company.description:
DexNet is a technology and blockchain-based project that aims to build a decentralized peer-to-peer (P2P) network infrastructure for secure data storage, communication, and digital services. The platform focuses on creating an alternative to traditional centralized internet systems by using distributed hardware devices called DexNodes that connect directly with each other.

The network allows users to access decentralized services such as cloud storage, mobile communication, and data transmission without relying on centralized servers. DexNodes act as micro-servers with high-performance processors, large SSD storage, and independent communication channels that enable secure data exchange across the network.
